name: Effects Of Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that sin fundamentally separates humanity from God, as our iniquities cause Him to hide His face and not hear us (Isaiah 59:2). All people have sinned and fallen short of God's glory (Romans 3:23), resulting in death entering the world through sin (Romans 5:12). Jesus teaches that those who commit sin become servants to it (John 8:34), yet through God's love and the gift of His Son, believers are granted eternal life and security in Him (John 3:16; John 10:28).
